risks.title: IsoMissionBase monolith
risks.evidence: Single script owns tile painting, marker indexing, runtime spawn for guards/cameras/alarms/routes, Louis geometry, code gates, poop decoy, debug export, authoring sync — thousands of lines.
risks.why_it_matters: Taco redesign changes will be high-conflict and hard to test in isolation.
risks.suggested_fix: Extract subsystems: RuntimeSpawner, RouteSubsystem, AlarmSubsystem, MarkerIndex, TacoBellFlavorAdapter.

risks.title: TacoBellDialogue preloaded in generic IsoMissionBase
risks.evidence: const TacoBellDialogue := preload(...) at top of IsoMissionBase.
risks.why_it_matters: Future non-Taco iso missions still load Taco dialogue type; violates mission-agnostic base.
risks.suggested_fix: Inject dialogue provider via mission_definition or optional child node.

risks.title: Player couples to mission root methods
risks.why_it_matters: Every new mission must expose same duck-typed API or throws break.
risks.suggested_fix: Autoload or group-resolved IToolMissionSurface / signal-based throw request.

risks.title: Dual Taco scene architectures
risks.evidence: RedesignTest adds many Phase0J/Phase0K scripts not present on Editable.
risks.why_it_matters: Teams may implement twice or merge wrong stack into production entry.
risks.suggested_fix: Declare canonical production scene in GameState/SceneManager and archive or merge test scene.

risks.title: Pause menu under test_ui path
risks.evidence: Production Taco scene instances test_ui pause menu.
risks.why_it_matters: Unclear contract for skinning/theming and hideout vs mission variants.
risks.suggested_fix: Move to mission UI package with same script initially (no behavior change).

risks.title: Objective state split QuestManager vs Iso dictionaries
risks.evidence: Iso tracks _required_objective_ids while QuestManager drives pause text.
risks.why_it_matters: Desync risk between HUD and internal mission gates.

risks.title: Hard-coded world cells for beam and Louis box
risks.evidence: Vector2i literals for garage beam and Louis corridor walls.
risks.suggested_fix: Drive from markers only; remove literals after marker bake stable.

risks.title: Attempt counter reset vs death without reload
risks.evidence: fail_level does not call Iso runtime reset; depends on scene reload path after result UI.
risks.why_it_matters: Violates must-not-forget if in-mission retry exists.
risks.suggested_fix: On attempt restart signal, call _setup_runtime_systems or subset reset.
